{{nihongo|'''Wonono Shrine'''|尾野神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Ise Province]].

=== History ===
The founding is said to date to the 28th year of {{ill|Emperor Sujin|ar|الإمبراطور سوجين|arz|الامبراطور سوجين|azb|سوجین (ایمپیراتور)|ca|Sujin|ckb|ئیمپراتۆر سوجین|cs|Sudžin|de|Sujin|el|Αυτοκράτορας Σουτζίν|es|Sujin Tennō|fa|امپراتور سوجین|fr|Sujin|hr|Sujin|id|Kaisar Sujin|it|Sujin|ja|崇神天皇|ka|სუძინი|ko|스진 천황|ms|Maharaja Sujin|nl|Sujin|pl|Sujin|pt|Sujin|ru|Император Судзин|sh|Car Sujin|simple|Emperor Sujin|sl|Cesar Sudžin|sr|Суџин|sv|Sujin|th|จักรพรรดิซูจิง|tl|Emperador Sujin|tr|Sujin (imparator)|uk|Імператор Судзін|uz|Imperator Sujin|vi|Thiên hoàng Sujin|yo|Emperor Sujin|zh|崇神天皇|zh_classical|崇神天皇|zh_min_nan|Suzin Thian-hông|zh_yue|崇神天皇|qid=Q333530}}. It is also considered a candidate site for the {{ill|Moto-Ise Shrines|ja|元伊勢|qid=Q11387775}} of the Kuwana Nodai-no-miya in {{ill|Ise Province|be|Ісэ (правінцыя)|ckb|پارێزگای ئیسێ|cs|Provincie Ise|de|Provinz Ise|es|Provincia de Ise|eu|Ise probintzia|fa|ولایت ایسه|fi|Isen provinssi|fr|Province d'Ise|gl|Provincia de Ise|hak|Yî-sṳ-koet|id|Provinsi Ise|it|Ise (provincia)|ja|伊勢国|ko|이세국|lt|Isės žemė|nl|Ise (provincie)|pt|Província de Ise|ru|Исэ (провинция)|simple|Ise Province|sk|Ise (provincia)|sr|Провинција Исе|tr|Ise (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Ісе|zh|伊勢國|zh_min_nan|Ise-kok|zh_yue|伊勢國|qid=Q864166}}. In ancient times, the shrine building stood atop a kofun (ancient burial mound). In the 10th year of {{ill|Eiroku|ca|Eiroku|ckb|ئێیرۆکو|fa|ایروکو|fr|Ère Eiroku|ja|永禄|ko|에이로쿠|ru|Эйроку|simple|Eiroku|sr|Еироку|sv|Eiroku|tr|Eiroku|zh|永祿|qid=Q1143341}}, it was burned down by {{ill|Oda Nobunaga|af|Oda Nobunaga|ar|أودا نوبوناغا|arz|اودا نوبوناجا|ast|Oda Nobunaga|az|Oda Nobunaqa|ban|Oda Nobunaga|bcl|Oda Nobunaga|be|Ода Набунага|bg|Ода Нобунага|bs|Oda Nobunaga|ca|Oda Nobunaga|cdo|Cék-dièng Séng-diòng|ckb|ئۆدا نۆبوناگا|cs|Nobunaga Oda|da|Oda Nobunaga|de|Oda Nobunaga|el|Όντα Νομπουνάγκα|eo|Oda Nobunaga|es|Oda Nobunaga|et|Oda Nobunaga|eu|Oda Nobunaga|fa|اودا نوبوناگا|fi|Oda Nobunaga|fr|Oda Nobunaga|gl|Oda Nobunaga|glk|اؤدا نؤبۊناگا|hak|Oda Nobunaga|he|אודה נובונאגה|hr|Oda Nobunaga|hu|Oda Nobunaga|id|Oda Nobunaga|is|Oda Nobunaga|it|Oda Nobunaga|ja|織田信長|ka|ოდა ნობუნაგა|kk|Ода Нобунага|ko|오다 노부나가|kw|Oda Nobunaga|la|Nobunanga|lt|Oda Nobunaga|lv|Oda Nobunaga|mg|Oda Nobunaga|mn|Ода Нобүнага|ms|Oda Nobunaga|nl|Oda Nobunaga|no|Oda Nobunaga|oc|Oda Nobunaga|pam|Nobunaga Oda|pl|Nobunaga Oda|pt|Oda Nobunaga|ro|Nobunaga Oda|ru|Ода Нобунага|sc|Oda Nobunaga|sh|Nobunaga Oda|simple|Oda Nobunaga|sk|Nobunaga Oda|sq|Oda Nobunaga|sr|Ода Нобунага|su|Oda Nobunaga|sv|Oda Nobunaga|tg|Ода Набунага|th|โอดะ โนบูนางะ|tl|Oda Nobunaga|tr|Oda Nobunaga|uk|Ода Нобунаґа|ur|اودا نوبوناگا|vi|Oda Nobunaga|war|Oda Nobunaga|wuu|织田信长|xmf|ოდა ნობუნაგა|zh|織田信長|zh_classical|織田信長|zh_min_nan|Oda Nobunaga|zh_yue|織田信長|zu|Oda Nobunaga|qid=Q171411}}, and the shrine building was moved to the base of the kofun. In the 29th year of {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}}, it was elevated to the rank of Prefectural Shrine. In Meiji 41 (1908), the Shikinaisha Tachisaka Shrine was amalgamated into it.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Ono Shrine|url=http://engishiki.org/ise/bun/is081307-01.html|access-date=2025-12-4}}</ref> The enshrined deity, Ōoshiobi Hikonomikoto, was a prince of {{ill|Emperor Kōshō|ar|الإمبراطور كوشو|arz|الامبراطور كوشو|azb|کوشو (ایمپیراتور)|ca|Kōshō|ckb|ئیمپراتۆر کۆشۆ|cs|Kóšó|de|Kōshō|eo|Koŝo (japana imperiestro)|es|Kōshō Tennō|fa|امپراتور کوشو|fi|Kōshō|fr|Kōshō (empereur)|he|קושו, קיסר יפן|hr|Kōshō|id|Kaisar Kōshō|it|Kōshō|ja|孝昭天皇|ka|კოსიო|ko|고쇼 천황|lt|Imperatorius Košio|ms|Maharaja Kōshō|nl|Kosho|pl|Kōshō|pt|Kosho (imperador)|ru|Император Косё|sh|Car Kōshō|simple|Emperor Kōshō|sl|Cesar Košo|sr|Кошо (јапански цар)|sv|Kõshõ|th|จักรพรรดิโคโช|tl|Emperador Kosho|tr|Kōshō (imparator)|uk|Імператор Косьо|uz|Imperator Kōshō|vi|Thiên hoàng Kōshō|zh|孝昭天皇|zh_min_nan|Kôsyô Thian-hông|zh_yue|孝昭天皇|qid=Q312841}}.
